leadText:
Myron (Japanese: ハッサク Hassaku) is a character of the day who appeared in Fight for the Light!. He is the grandfather of Olivine City Gym Leader Jasmine.

He helped Jasmine to take care of Sparkle when it was ill. Later, he advised to challenge the Cianwood Gym before challenging Jasmine, to give her time to get ready for battle.

Myron commended Janina, Jasmine's Gym apprentice, and her quick thinking after she used her as a rope to stop from escaping with Sparkle. His accolades helped Jasmine trust Janina after she pretended to be the Olivine Gym Leader and coated her Onix in wax to give it an unfair advantage in .

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
His shirt is printed with oranges, which may be a reference to his and his granddaughter's Japanese names—Hassaku and Mikan respectively—both of which are types of citrus fruits.
